payload.entry: LANDING REVIEW / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Read this epic and every note on phases bob-cli-fs.10.1.1-.4, both linked plans, the parent phase DECISIONS, the combined source and tests, and linked-repo commits 4b8db34, 52a222a, e3f0817, 5e95b8f. No child contains a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entry. No genuinely distinct unrelated follow-up was found; no proposals were declined and no task bead is warranted. The recorded unavailable-Mac attempts are permitted best-effort limits, not a separate task. All newly found gaps are caused by this epic and remain epic work. (1) RelationLabelPromptCard assigns color in switch arms inside ViewBuilder; a minimal Swift 6 result-builder typecheck reproduces the Void-expression error. (2) PullInSectionIdentity includes relation.label for non-relation offers, so a hand-off with a relation second reason fails to join Bob group metadata, splits sections, and loses copy/order; detailText/accessibility omit second-reason meta and contextText still derives legacy copy when Bob copy exists. (3) Rust emits reason=blocked with scheduled/project metadata, but CaptureRelationHeldPresentation only recognizes synthetic reason=scheduled/project, displaying waits on 0 for actual rows. (4) Single toggle and nested relation-complete notifications bypass the batch pulledInSummary, dropping selected relation counts; held/check notices are not consistently aggregated across those routes and task/Pomodoro completion appends held notices after a picker was used. These require one medium repair tale, including the final landing. Integration: fetched both origins; Mac HEAD 5e95b8f has only the four epic commits since a58e4f0, with no later external commits. Primary HEAD 807e1816 includes five post-start commits (15d18e90, 817ba7dd, a9a499ac, 4d5a61de, 807e1816): clock-tag parsing, clock agenda/settle/stats, gcal clock tags, and freshness docs/memory. They do not change relation output/group keys or require Mac relation planner logic; preserve them. Fixture provenance 71907dab remains relevant to the relation contract. bash -n of the generator and aggregate git diff --check pass. epic-symbols for bob-cli-fs.10.1 and bob-cli-fs.10 are empty. Combined portable/docs gates and native best-effort verification must follow the repairs before normal close of this epic and parent phase bob-cli-fs.10; containing epic bob-cli-fs belongs to its waiting lander.

RECOVERY LANDING REVIEW: git status/diff were clean in the primary and opened Mac checkouts; the ignored repair tale from the previous attempt was preserved. Re-read the epic, every note on all four child phases, the parent phase and its final DECISIONS, and both linked plans. Rechecked source for all four recorded defects against the Rust group/held contract, child commit attribution, and notification/test routes; the defects remain and are epic work. Follow-up triage remains complete: zero PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries, no unrelated findings, no declined proposals, and no new task bead warranted. Re-fetched both origins: Mac remains 5e95b8f; primary origin/master advanced from 807e1816 to 0346d828 with decay-ladder documentation/navigation/registry-test changes only, requiring no relation integration. Both epic-symbol checks remain empty. The preserved medium repair tale now includes this drift and the corrected relation_held_row_json source locator; validation with --explain and revalidation both passed. Its mandatory final step repairs and verifies the combined feature, closes bob-cli-fs.10.1, marks its linked plan done, and normally closes only parent phase bob-cli-fs.10. Product verification remains pending those repairs; no product edits or test pass are claimed by this planning recovery.

Repair landing: fixed RelationLabelPromptCard ViewBuilder color assignment via helper; joined pull-in groups by primary relation reason only and preserved Bob order/copy with deterministic fallback, respected supplied copy in context line, reused shared meta path for detail/accessibility with lane-only status and suppressed raw relation trigger; mirrored Rust held precedence scheduled>project>count for reason:blocked and centralized held/check presentation across toggles/task/Pomodoro/nested/batches with no-picker gate and explicit none silence; integrated shared picked summary on every single/batch notification route with opaque-key dedupe and no double second summary. Checked all four closed phase notes, combined commits 4b8db34/52a222a/e3f0817/5e95b8f, and both linked plans. Integration: Mac HEAD 5e95b8f unchanged; primary at 0346d828 for build/generator (fresh debug Bob 0.4.0) plus new origin beae4dc7 inspected (pomodoro-clock clock_note only, no relation wire change). Verification: just portable-check exit 0 (2044 tests), just docs-check exit 0 (447 passed), bash -n generator ok, git diff-check clean, generator ran against explicitly built Bob with 5 new real fixtures (toggle-selected, nested-selected, held-scheduled, held-project, handoff-secondary) and unchanged old fixtures. Mac SSH timed out (kellys-macbook-pro, 10s), so macOS bundle/typecheck-tests unverified; portable compilation passed and source-proven ViewBuilder defect fixed.
